A landmark account of comparative investigation into a devastating disease, with lasting value for understanding the development of medical evidence. It also shows the distance between a useful observation and an adequate explanation.
entries.reading: A landmark account of comparative investigation into a devastating disease, with lasting value for understanding the development of medical evidence. It also shows the distance between a useful observation and an adequate explanation.
entries.caveat: The 1747 comparison involved very few sailors and was not a modern randomized trial. Lind's causal explanations and some recommendations were wrong; the later vitamin-C explanation should not be attributed to him.

entries.standing: Position 103 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A searching critique of inherited chemical categories, using experimental argument to question familiar claims about the composition of matter. Its open-ended reasoning is more important than any single modern-sounding definition.
entries.reading: A searching critique of inherited chemical categories, using experimental argument to question familiar claims about the composition of matter. Its open-ended reasoning is more important than any single modern-sounding definition.
entries.caveat: Boyle was not simply a modern chemist overthrowing all alchemy. His corpuscular programme and concepts of elements differ from current atomic chemistry; the dialogue presents objections rather than a completed modern periodic system.

entries.standing: Position 104 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An influential teaching synthesis that organizes chemical knowledge through recurring properties and systematic comparison. Its importance joins explanatory architecture with the development of the periodic classification.
entries.reading: An influential teaching synthesis that organizes chemical knowledge through recurring properties and systematic comparison. Its importance joins explanatory architecture with the development of the periodic classification.
entries.caveat: The framework predates atomic number, quantum mechanics and modern bonding theory. Editions expanded considerably; the consulted English sixth-edition translation represents a later state of the work, not the original Russian instalments.

entries.standing: Position 105 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. Uses one familiar molecule to connect chemistry, physical properties, life and planetary processes. The subject's apparent simplicity becomes a route into deep questions about matter.
entries.reading: Uses one familiar molecule to connect chemistry, physical properties, life and planetary processes. The subject's apparent simplicity becomes a route into deep questions about matter.
entries.caveat: Water's unusual properties have well-supported explanations, but not every proposed structural model or biological implication is settled. The 1999 synthesis predates subsequent experimental and computational work; 'water memory' is not established by molecular complexity.

entries.standing: Position 106 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An ambitious visual and conceptual explanation of thermodynamics, making entropy central to understanding natural change. It rewards readers seeking more depth than the familiar shorthand of 'disorder'.
entries.reading: An ambitious visual and conceptual explanation of thermodynamics, making entropy central to understanding natural change. It rewards readers seeking more depth than the familiar shorthand of 'disorder'.
entries.caveat: Entropy is not simply visible messiness, and its statistical meaning requires care. The second law constrains isolated systems; local organization does not violate it. Biological or cosmological extensions need assumptions beyond the law itself.

entries.standing: Position 107 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A distinctive Chilean synthesis linking biological organization, perception and cognition. Its systemic approach makes knowing a question about living activity rather than detached representation alone.
entries.reading: A distinctive Chilean synthesis linking biological organization, perception and cognition. Its systemic approach makes knowing a question about living activity rather than detached representation alone.
entries.caveat: Autopoiesis is an influential framework, not a complete experimentally confirmed theory of cognition. Biological description and epistemological conclusions need separate evaluation; the 1984 Spanish text and later translations differ in presentation.

entries.standing: Position 108 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A vast, intellectually serious reconstruction of central biological ideas about diversity, evolution and inheritance. Its depth makes it valuable for understanding how a major evolutionary thinker organized the history of his science.
entries.reading: A vast, intellectually serious reconstruction of central biological ideas about diversity, evolution and inheritance. Its depth makes it valuable for understanding how a major evolutionary thinker organized the history of his science.
entries.caveat: Mayr's disciplinary commitments shape the narrative and its judgments about progress. Later histories give different weight to development, molecular biology, institutions and contributors; it is not an impartial encyclopaedia of every biological tradition.

entries.standing: Position 109 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. Explains the production and loss of biological diversity across evolutionary and ecological scales. Its synthesis gives conservation a scientifically substantial narrative and helped broaden public attention to biodiversity.
entries.reading: Explains the production and loss of biological diversity across evolutionary and ecological scales. Its synthesis gives conservation a scientifically substantial narrative and helped broaden public attention to biodiversity.
entries.caveat: Global species totals and extinction estimates remain uncertain, and the 1992 numbers need updating. Conservation values do not follow automatically from evolutionary theory; the book's broader claims should be assessed separately from Wilson's expertise in particular organisms.

entries.standing: Position 110 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A scientific biography in which chromosome behaviour, experimental attention and conceptual discovery remain central. It makes the relationship between close knowledge of an organism and theoretical innovation unusually vivid.
entries.reading: A scientific biography in which chromosome behaviour, experimental attention and conceptual discovery remain central. It makes the relationship between close knowledge of an organism and theoretical innovation unusually vivid.
entries.caveat: McClintock's genetic findings are well established, but the interpretation of her reception and distinctive scientific style is debated. Do not turn an individual's observational skill into a universal claim about gender or a method independent of testable evidence.

entries.standing: Position 111 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. Introduces great mathematical results through their proofs and historical settings. Its distinctive virtue is allowing readers to experience the logic of an argument rather than admire an unexplained achievement.
entries.reading: Introduces great mathematical results through their proofs and historical settings. Its distinctive virtue is allowing readers to experience the logic of an argument rather than admire an unexplained achievement.
entries.caveat: School algebra and geometry are helpful, and some chapters require substantial concentration. The chosen route through mathematical history is selective and largely European; narrative simplification should not be mistaken for complete historical coverage.

entries.standing: Position 112 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A miniature of remarkable clarity and literary economy, opening difficult physical ideas to readers with little preparation. Its compression makes it an effective invitation to further scientific reading.
entries.reading: A miniature of remarkable clarity and literary economy, opening difficult physical ideas to readers with little preparation. Its compression makes it an effective invitation to further scientific reading.
entries.caveat: Brevity limits depth. The book moves between established relativity and quantum theory, statistical arguments and less settled quantum-gravity ideas; these do not all have equal experimental support.

entries.standing: Position 113 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An unusually graceful account of why everyday intuitions about time become inadequate in physics. It joins thermodynamics, relativity and foundational questions with considerable conceptual ambition.
entries.reading: An unusually graceful account of why everyday intuitions about time become inadequate in physics. It joins thermodynamics, relativity and foundational questions with considerable conceptual ambition.
entries.caveat: The argument becomes harder than its lyrical style suggests. Interpretations of time, especially those linked to quantum gravity, are not a settled consensus; philosophical conclusions must be separated from experimentally established physical relations.

entries.standing: Position 114 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. Explains how radical astronomical ideas move from conjecture toward acceptance through instruments, evidence and theoretical revision. Its attention to the process of changing a cosmic picture gives the history scientific substance.
entries.reading: Explains how radical astronomical ideas move from conjecture toward acceptance through instruments, evidence and theoretical revision. Its attention to the process of changing a cosmic picture gives the history scientific substance.
entries.caveat: The 2016 account predates important later observations. Dark matter and dark energy remain unresolved in their underlying nature, and multiverse proposals are unconfirmed; examples of successful radical ideas do not imply that every currently speculative idea will be vindicated.

entries.standing: Position 115 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An exceptionally accomplished explanation of the tensions among relativity, quantum theory and attempts at unification. Its analogies and progression make very abstract theoretical physics approachable.
entries.reading: An exceptionally accomplished explanation of the tensions among relativity, quantum theory and attempts at unification. Its analogies and progression make very abstract theoretical physics approachable.
entries.caveat: String theory's proposed unification is not experimentally established. Extra dimensions and particular models are not observational discoveries; the book's explanatory success should not be confused with confirmation of its preferred research programme.

entries.standing: Position 116 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A foundational reflection on probability as a means of reasoning under uncertainty, joining mathematical ideas to scientific and everyday problems. Its influence extends far beyond the specific applications.
entries.reading: A foundational reflection on probability as a means of reasoning under uncertainty, joining mathematical ideas to scientific and everyday problems. Its influence extends far beyond the specific applications.
entries.caveat: Deterministic metaphysics is not required for modern probability. Some social and evidential assumptions are dated, and the apparently informal essay can be conceptually demanding. Modern Bayesian and frequentist practice should not be collapsed into this text.

entries.standing: Position 117 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A formative synthesis of feedback, control and communication across machines and organisms. Its originality lies in a shared explanatory vocabulary that opened productive connections among disciplines.
entries.reading: A formative synthesis of feedback, control and communication across machines and organisms. Its originality lies in a shared explanatory vocabulary that opened productive connections among disciplines.
entries.caveat: Not every biological or social analogy is a demonstrated mechanism. It is mathematically demanding and historically uneven; the 1961 additions matter. Modern control theory, computation and neuroscience greatly exceed its original framework.

entries.standing: Position 118 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A highly influential organization of statistical methods for working researchers, linking experimental data with explicit inferential procedures. Its teaching impact helped shape scientific practice across fields.
entries.reading: A highly influential organization of statistical methods for working researchers, linking experimental data with explicit inferential procedures. Its teaching impact helped shape scientific practice across fields.
entries.caveat: Tests depend on design and model assumptions; a small p-value does not measure effect importance or the probability a hypothesis is true. Later methods address many limitations. Fisher's eugenic commitments must be distinguished from evaluating particular statistical results.

entries.standing: Position 119 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A powerful narrative explanation of heredity, genetic discovery and the implications of learning to read and alter biological information. Scientific concepts and family history are integrated with considerable skill.
entries.reading: A powerful narrative explanation of heredity, genetic discovery and the implications of learning to read and alter biological information. Scientific concepts and family history are integrated with considerable skill.
entries.caveat: Genotype does not uniquely determine a person's fate. Complex traits, gene regulation and epigenetic mechanisms need more qualification than narrative shorthand permits; genetic technologies and clinical applications have changed since 2016.

entries.standing: Position 120 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An effective explanation of fair tests, misleading statistics, placebo effects and distorted evidence in public medicine. Its polemical energy is backed by an accessible account of how claims should be assessed.
entries.reading: An effective explanation of fair tests, misleading statistics, placebo effects and distorted evidence in public medicine. Its polemical energy is backed by an accessible account of how claims should be assessed.
entries.caveat: Individual controversies and examples date, and sharp rhetoric can simplify uncertainty. The book equips readers to ask better questions; it does not supply current evidence about every product, condition or treatment.

entries.standing: Position 121 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. Scientific natural history becomes a distinctive form of reflective prose, with evolutionary time and the material world at its centre. Its literary quality gives otherwise abstract biological questions emotional and intellectual force.
entries.reading: Scientific natural history becomes a distinctive form of reflective prose, with evolutionary time and the material world at its centre. Its literary quality gives otherwise abstract biological questions emotional and intellectual force.
entries.caveat: Metaphor and philosophical reflection often extend beyond what observation alone establishes. Some evolutionary details are dated; read the essays as informed interpretation rather than a modern synthesis of biological mechanisms.

entries.standing: Position 122 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A major attempt to organize animal behaviour into experimentally investigable problems. Its conceptual discipline helped make ethology a systematic explanatory science.
entries.reading: A major attempt to organize animal behaviour into experimentally investigable problems. Its conceptual discipline helped make ethology a systematic explanatory science.
entries.caveat: Early drive and instinct models have been substantially revised, and innate versus learned behaviour is rarely a clean division. Later developmental and ecological approaches add mechanisms absent from the 1951 synthesis.

entries.standing: Position 123 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An extraordinary sustained investigation of insect behaviour, combining patient observation, intervention and memorable prose. Its continuing readership across languages supports its standing as scientific natural history.
entries.reading: An extraordinary sustained investigation of insect behaviour, combining patient observation, intervention and memorable prose. Its continuing readership across languages supports its standing as scientific natural history.
entries.caveat: Fabre's opposition to evolutionary theory limits some interpretations of instinct. Experiments and anecdotes need to be judged individually. The ten-volume original, translated selections and children's retellings are very different reading experiences.

entries.standing: Position 124 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A major account of tropical natural history, geographical distribution and field observation. Its scientific importance and descriptive strength make it more than a travel classic.
entries.reading: A major account of tropical natural history, geographical distribution and field observation. Its scientific importance and descriptive strength make it more than a travel classic.
entries.caveat: Colonial and racial assumptions require critical reading, and collecting methods reflect a different era. Species names and biogeographical explanations have changed; the whole two-volume work is counted once.

entries.standing: Position 125 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An ambitious synthesis that made natural history a large public and intellectual enterprise. Its attention to organisms, environments and variation expanded the questions an account of nature could address.
entries.reading: An ambitious synthesis that made natural history a large public and intellectual enterprise. Its attention to organisms, environments and variation expanded the questions an account of nature could address.
entries.caveat: Many biological and geological explanations are obsolete. Authorship is collaborative, and editions often include later continuations by other writers; this entry covers Buffon's core project rather than every volume marketed under the title.

entries.standing: Position 126 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A foundational argument for understanding Earth through recurring physical processes and immense timescales. Its scope helped make geological history an autonomous scientific problem.
entries.reading: A foundational argument for understanding Earth through recurring physical processes and immense timescales. Its scope helped make geological history an autonomous scientific problem.
entries.caveat: Hutton's cyclic framework is not a modern account of Earth's origin or tectonics. Dense prose and organization are major barriers; the 1795 book develops the earlier 1788 paper and should not be confused with later expositions by others.

entries.standing: Position 127 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A landmark in turning physical change into mathematical analysis. The treatment of heat flow and representation by trigonometric series had extraordinary consequences for physics and mathematics.
entries.reading: A landmark in turning physical change into mathematical analysis. The treatment of heat flow and representation by trigonometric series had extraordinary consequences for physics and mathematics.
entries.caveat: Its continuum models have domains of validity, and later mathematics supplies conditions missing from some original arguments. Quantum and microscopic accounts of heat go beyond this work; advanced mathematics and historical notation make it demanding.

entries.standing: Position 128 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. Explains civilization through the physical constraints and transformations of energy use, connecting food, labour, fuels and industrial systems. Quantitative breadth is its defining strength.
entries.reading: Explains civilization through the physical constraints and transformations of energy use, connecting food, labour, fuels and industrial systems. Quantitative breadth is its defining strength.
entries.caveat: Energy is a crucial constraint, not a sufficient cause of every social development. Historical estimates vary in quality, and recent energy technologies and emissions data need updating beyond the 2017 account.

entries.standing: Position 129 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An exemplary explanation of environmental contamination through chemistry, epidemiology and the difficulty of establishing causation. The scientific investigation gives the community narrative analytical depth.
entries.reading: An exemplary explanation of environmental contamination through chemistry, epidemiology and the difficulty of establishing causation. The scientific investigation gives the community narrative analytical depth.
entries.caveat: A local cancer cluster is not, by itself, proof of a particular cause. Exposure reconstruction and statistical power impose limits; legal conclusions and scientific causal claims answer related but different questions.

entries.standing: Position 130 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An ambitious explanation of photosynthesis connecting molecular processes, evolutionary history and the planet's atmosphere. Its breadth makes an apparently familiar process intellectually surprising.
entries.reading: An ambitious explanation of photosynthesis connecting molecular processes, evolutionary history and the planet's atmosphere. Its breadth makes an apparently familiar process intellectually surprising.
entries.caveat: Mechanistic details and earth-history reconstructions differ in certainty. Climate and biogeochemical findings have advanced since 2007; the literary synthesis should not obscure unresolved questions about ancient environments or feedback strength.

entries.standing: Position 131 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An influential Korean invitation to science through unexpected patterns in everyday life, linking accessible examples to complexity and quantitative reasoning. Its public reach and locally situated explanatory voice broaden this ranking's traditions.
entries.reading: An influential Korean invitation to science through unexpected patterns in everyday life, linking accessible examples to complexity and quantitative reasoning. Its public reach and locally situated explanatory voice broaden this ranking's traditions.
entries.caveat: The 2001 examples and later revisions should not be conflated. Attractive links between social patterns and physical models need independent evidence; the book is an exploratory introduction rather than a validated universal theory of society.

entries.standing: Position 132 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An unusually effective short explanation of a practical scientific problem through timekeeping, instruments and competing approaches. It gives technical development a clear narrative without requiring mathematical preparation.
entries.reading: An unusually effective short explanation of a practical scientific problem through timekeeping, instruments and competing approaches. It gives technical development a clear narrative without requiring mathematical preparation.
entries.caveat: The Harrison-centred story compresses collective work and can simplify the role of lunar-distance methods and scientific institutions. It is an introduction to the longitude problem, not a comprehensive history of navigation.

entries.standing: Position 133 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. Botanical explanation and scientific memoir reinforce one another through vivid accounts of trees, soils, experiments and fieldwork. Its literary strengths are grounded in sustained attention to living systems.
entries.reading: Botanical explanation and scientific memoir reinforce one another through vivid accounts of trees, soils, experiments and fieldwork. Its literary strengths are grounded in sustained attention to living systems.
entries.caveat: The scientific passages are selective, and personal experience is not representative of all research careers. Plant descriptions may use personification; that device should be distinguished from literal claims about intention or human-like experience.

entries.standing: Position 134 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. Connects cosmological ideas, their historical development and the cultural search for origins in an unusually expansive popular account. Its Brazilian reception adds evidence of reach beyond Anglophone science-writing circuits.
entries.reading: Connects cosmological ideas, their historical development and the cultural search for origins in an unusually expansive popular account. Its Brazilian reception adds evidence of reach beyond Anglophone science-writing circuits.
entries.caveat: Scientific cosmology and religious or philosophical creation stories have different evidential standing. The 1997 science predates major later cosmological results. English and Portuguese editions appeared that year; composition-language priority was not securely established here.

entries.standing: Position 135 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A highly original account of the brain as an active generator of organized behaviour and mental experience. Its connection of movement, prediction and neural dynamics gives it substantial explanatory ambition.
entries.reading: A highly original account of the brain as an active generator of organized behaviour and mental experience. Its connection of movement, prediction and neural dynamics gives it substantial explanatory ambition.
entries.caveat: It advances a particular theoretical synthesis. Oscillations and motor organization are important, but they do not constitute an agreed complete explanation of consciousness; the 2001 account predates many later methods and findings.

entries.standing: Position 136 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A concise account of human origins grounded in African fossils and questions about behaviour, anatomy and evolutionary change. Its clarity gives readers a useful view of how palaeoanthropological evidence is interpreted.
entries.reading: A concise account of human origins grounded in African fossils and questions about behaviour, anatomy and evolutionary change. Its clarity gives readers a useful view of how palaeoanthropological evidence is interpreted.
entries.caveat: Ancient DNA, new fossils and revised dating have transformed the field since 1994. Some family trees and behavioural inferences are outdated; current human evolution is branching and includes interbreeding, not a single ladder.

entries.standing: Position 137 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A substantial South African scientific and public-health synthesis rooted in one of the world's most consequential epidemics. Its integration of epidemiology, prevention, treatment and social context justifies inclusion beyond narrative popular science.
entries.reading: A substantial South African scientific and public-health synthesis rooted in one of the world's most consequential epidemics. Its integration of epidemiology, prevention, treatment and social context justifies inclusion beyond narrative popular science.
entries.caveat: The 2005 first edition is clinically outdated. Later editions and current evidence must guide treatment and prevention; effective antiretroviral therapy has radically changed prognosis and transmission. The book's importance is contextual and explanatory, not the timelessness of its original recommendations.

entries.standing: Position 138 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An influential field guide that made Indian ornithology accessible through identification, description and attention to birds in their habitats. It represents scientific natural history as a practice readers can undertake themselves.
entries.reading: An influential field guide that made Indian ornithology accessible through identification, description and attention to birds in their habitats. It represents scientific natural history as a practice readers can undertake themselves.
entries.caveat: Taxonomy, species limits, conservation status and distribution records change. Revised editions should be distinguished from the 1941 original, and a national guide is not comprehensive coverage of every South Asian bird.

entries.standing: Position 139 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An original attempt to investigate responses across living tissues and non-living materials through carefully designed instruments. Its value lies in experimental comparison and a challenge to easy disciplinary boundaries.
entries.reading: An original attempt to investigate responses across living tissues and non-living materials through carefully designed instruments. Its value lies in experimental comparison and a challenge to easy disciplinary boundaries.
entries.caveat: Similar electrical response curves do not demonstrate that metals have consciousness or that all biological and non-biological mechanisms are identical. Instrumental and physiological interpretation must be reassessed in light of modern biophysics.

entries.standing: Position 140 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A major Arabic compilation in which animals, environments and observation are central, embedded in a richly argumentative literary culture. It reveals a scientific natural-history tradition often absent from English-language rankings.
entries.reading: A major Arabic compilation in which animals, environments and observation are central, embedded in a richly argumentative literary culture. It reveals a scientific natural-history tradition often absent from English-language rankings.
entries.caveat: It mixes zoological observation with anecdotes, literature and theological argument. Descriptions of struggle and adaptation should not be relabelled as Darwin's theory of natural selection. Manuscript history and the selection in translations affect accessibility.

entries.standing: Position 141 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A powerful specimen of nineteenth-century public physics, explaining thermal phenomena through experiments and a mechanical conception of heat. Tyndall's skill at making invisible processes experimentally tangible remains its main attraction.
entries.reading: A powerful specimen of nineteenth-century public physics, explaining thermal phenomena through experiments and a mechanical conception of heat. Tyndall's skill at making invisible processes experimentally tangible remains its main attraction.
entries.caveat: The account predates quantum theory and modern molecular physics. Particular models, terminology and experimental practices are historical; its place in the development of climate-related knowledge should not be reduced to a single-founder story.

entries.standing: Position 142 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A compact, thoughtful explanation of statistical reasoning by a major contributor to the field. It connects uncertainty, scientific inference and real problems without treating statistics as a collection of mechanical recipes.
entries.reading: A compact, thoughtful explanation of statistical reasoning by a major contributor to the field. It connects uncertainty, scientific inference and real problems without treating statistics as a collection of mechanical recipes.
entries.caveat: Philosophical interpretations of probability and inference remain contested. Examples and available techniques reflect their edition; the 1989 first edition and expanded later text should not be treated as identical.

entries.standing: Position 143 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An engaging explanation of gravity from familiar experience to relativity and astronomical consequences. Its accessibility is strengthened by Narlikar's long commitment to public scientific understanding in India.
entries.reading: An engaging explanation of gravity from familiar experience to relativity and astronomical consequences. Its accessibility is strengthened by Narlikar's long commitment to public scientific understanding in India.
entries.caveat: Some simple equations and sustained conceptual work are required. The 1982 original and 1996 second edition predate major later observations; speculative cosmological positions should be distinguished from well-supported gravitational physics.

entries.standing: Position 144 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. Makes mathematical curiosity publicly accessible through problems, surprising arguments and conversational explanation. Its strong Spanish-language readership demonstrates lasting value outside specialist mathematical culture.
entries.reading: Makes mathematical curiosity publicly accessible through problems, surprising arguments and conversational explanation. Its strong Spanish-language readership demonstrates lasting value outside specialist mathematical culture.
entries.caveat: This is the first book in a larger series, not the whole series ranked together. Puzzle-solving is not a substitute for a systematic curriculum, and some readers find its informal level uneven rather than consistently demanding.

entries.standing: Position 145 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An ambitious Brazilian account of dreaming that links sleep research, memory, evolution and the history of ideas. Its scientific range and distinctive synthesis give it value beyond a conventional sleep primer.
entries.reading: An ambitious Brazilian account of dreaming that links sleep research, memory, evolution and the history of ideas. Its scientific range and distinctive synthesis give it value beyond a conventional sleep primer.
entries.caveat: Proposed functions of dreams and broad evolutionary interpretations remain contested. Cultural and psychoanalytic interpretations do not have the same evidential status as laboratory sleep findings; the 2019 account is not a settled theory or treatment guide.

entries.standing: Position 146 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A forcefully written examination of how measurement and theories of intelligence can embody assumptions about human difference. Its critical influence and ability to provoke methodological scrutiny justify inclusion, with a substantial reliability penalty.
entries.reading: A forcefully written examination of how measurement and theories of intelligence can embody assumptions about human difference. Its critical influence and ability to provoke methodological scrutiny justify inclusion, with a substantial reliability penalty.
entries.caveat: Gould's account of Morton's skull measurements is challenged by direct reanalysis. That dispute does not vindicate racial hierarchies, nor does the book settle modern psychometrics. Read it as a contested historical argument, especially across the 1981 and 1996 editions.

entries.standing: Position 147 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An influential and lucid synthesis of judgment, uncertainty and systematic errors in intuition. Its strongest material explains consequential experimental findings and the limits of unaided probability judgments.
entries.reading: An influential and lucid synthesis of judgment, uncertainty and systematic errors in intuition. Its strongest material explains consequential experimental findings and the limits of unaided probability judgments.
entries.caveat: Confidence must vary by chapter: some social-priming examples failed replication or rested on weak evidence. The two systems are explanatory shorthand, not two literal brain organs. These weaknesses lower its rank; they do not invalidate every bias or prospect-theory result.

entries.standing: Position 148 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. An extraordinary compilation of substances, observations, classifications and earlier medical literature. Its importance includes natural history and the critical organization of knowledge in late-imperial China.
entries.reading: An extraordinary compilation of substances, observations, classifications and earlier medical literature. Its importance includes natural history and the critical organization of knowledge in late-imperial China.
entries.caveat: Traditional indications are not demonstrations of efficacy or safety; some ingredients and treatments are hazardous. Historical names are difficult to identify precisely, and the book's authority cannot substitute for modern toxicological or clinical evidence.

entries.standing: Position 149 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A major Korean organization of medical knowledge, valued for its synthesis, structure and transmission of practical learning. Its inclusion recognizes a historically consequential scientific tradition rather than modern efficacy.
entries.reading: A major Korean organization of medical knowledge, valued for its synthesis, structure and transmission of practical learning. Its inclusion recognizes a historically consequential scientific tradition rather than modern efficacy.
entries.caveat: Written in Classical Chinese and first printed in 1613, following earlier compilation. Historical physiological theories and many remedies are unsupported or unsafe by current standards. UNESCO recognition concerns documentary heritage, not clinical validation.

entries.standing: Position 150 in the owner-supplied Science books · All time synthesis. A vast surviving record of ancient attempts to collect and organize knowledge of nature, especially valuable for plants, animals, minerals and materials. Its historical influence exceeds its present explanatory reliability.
entries.reading: A vast surviving record of ancient attempts to collect and organize knowledge of nature, especially valuable for plants, animals, minerals and materials. Its historical influence exceeds its present explanatory reliability.
entries.caveat: It combines observation, borrowed reports, errors and marvellous claims, including ineffective or hazardous remedies. Inclusion is historical, not endorsement. Modern selections can conceal how heterogeneous the 37-book original actually is.
